scenes.title: Called by God to a New Land
scenes.english_text: Long ago, a kind man named Abraham lived in a busy city called Ur. One day, God spoke to Abraham and said, 'Leave your home and go to a new land that I will show you.' Abraham did not know where he was going, but he trusted God completely. He packed his tents, took his family, and set off on a great journey of faith.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha tempu uluk, mane di'ak ida naran Abraão hela iha sidade boot naran Ur. Loron ida, Maromak ko'alia ba Abraão no dehan, 'Husik ó-nia uma no ba rai foun ne'ebé Ha'u sei hatudu ba ó.' Abraão la hatene nia sei ba ne'ebé, maibé nia fiar Maromak ho laran tomak. Nia halibur nia tenda sira, lori nia família, no hahú la'o ho fiar.
scenes.scene_summary: Abraham listens to God's voice and obediently leaves his hometown Ur for an unknown promised land.

scenes.title: Choosing Peace with Lot
scenes.english_text: As time passed, Abraham and his nephew Lot had many sheep and cattle. Their workers started to argue because there was not enough grass for all the animals. Instead of getting angry, Abraham warmly said to Lot, 'Let us not fight. Choose the land you like best first.' Lot chose the rich green valley, and Abraham happily took the other side, showing a loving heart.
scenes.tetum_translation: Nu'udar tempu la'o, Abraão no nia maun-alin nia oan Lot iha bibi no karau barak. Sira-nia trebadór sira hahú istoriadu tanba du'ut la to'o ba animál hotu. Duké hirus, Abraão ko'alia ho laran-di'ak ba Lot, 'Keta halo istória. Hili tiha rai ne'ebé ó gosta liu.' Lot hili rai-klean ne'ebé matak, no Abraão foti parte seluk ho haksolok.
scenes.scene_summary: Abraham generously lets his nephew Lot choose the best green land first to keep peace between their families.

scenes.title: God's Promise of the Stars
scenes.english_text: One quiet night, God brought Abraham outside under the dark blue sky. God pointed upward and said, 'Look at the sky and count the stars if you can! Your family will be as many as these bright stars.' Abraham was very old and had no children yet, but he believed God's wonderful promise with all his heart.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha kalohan-laek kalan ida, Maromak lori Abraão ba sai iha li'ur iha lalehan nakukun okos. Maromak hatudu ba leten no dehan, 'Haree ba lalehan no sura fitun sira se ó bele! Ó-nia umakain sei barak hanesan fitun naroman sira-ne'e.' Abraão katuas tebes no seidauk iha oan, maibé nia fiar Maromak nia promesa furak ne'e.
scenes.scene_summary: God leads Abraham out under the night sky and promises that his descendants will be as numerous as the stars.

scenes.title: Trusting God Through Hard Times
scenes.english_text: Waiting for God's promise was not easy, and many years went by. Abraham and his wife Sarah felt sad and tried to solve things in their own human way, which brought trouble to their home. Yet, even when things got difficult with Hagar and Ishmael, God reminded Abraham that He had not forgotten them and would still keep His holy promise.
scenes.tetum_translation: Hein ba Maromak nia promesa la fasil, no tinan barak liu ba. Abraão no nia feen Sara sente triste no koko resolve ho sira-nia dalan rasik, ne'ebé lori susar ba sira-nia uma. Maibé, maski susar mosu ho Agar no Ismael, Maromak hanoin-hetan Abraão katak Nia la haluha sira no sei kumpre Nia liafuan santu.
scenes.scene_summary: Abraham and Sarah face family struggles while waiting, but God reassures Abraham of His faithful covenant.

scenes.title: Praying for Sodom
scenes.english_text: When Abraham heard that the city of Sodom was in great danger because of its wickedness, he thought of his nephew Lot living there. Abraham humbly stepped forward and prayed to God again and again, asking, 'Will You spare the city if there are good people inside?' God listened patiently to Abraham's caring prayer, showing His great mercy.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Abraão rona katak sidade Sodoma iha perigu boot tanba sira-nia aat, nia hanoin nia maun-alin nia oan Lot ne'ebé hela iha ne'ebá. Abraão ho haraik-an ko'alia no husu ba Maromak beibeik, 'Katak Ita sei halai husi sidade ne'e se iha ema di'ak iha laran?' Maromak rona ho pásia ba Abraão nia orasaun laran-luak.
scenes.scene_summary: Abraham humbly pleads with God in prayer to save the city of Sodom for the sake of the righteous people.

scenes.title: The Joyful Birth of Isaac
scenes.english_text: Exactly as God had promised, a miracle happened! When Abraham was one hundred years old, his wife Sarah gave birth to a healthy baby boy. They named him Isaac, which means 'laughter,' because their house was filled with pure joy. Abraham held his little son close and thanked God for His faithful gift.
scenes.tetum_translation: Hanesan loloos Maromak promete tiha, milagre ida mosu! Bainhira Abraão tinan atus ida, nia feen Sara ko'us oan-mane isin-di'ak ida. Sira fó naran Isak ba nia, ne'ebé dehan 'hamasa', tanba sira-nia uma haksolok tebes. Abraão hakuak nia oan-mane ki'ik no agradese ba Maromak nia prezente fidél.
scenes.scene_summary: God fulfills His promise as baby Isaac is born to 100-year-old Abraham and Sarah, filling their home with laughter.

scenes.title: The Test of Faith on Mount Moriah
scenes.english_text: One day, God tested Abraham's heart by asking him to offer his beloved son Isaac as a special sacrifice on Mount Moriah. Though his heart was heavy, Abraham trusted God completely and obeyed. Just as Abraham raised his hand in faith, God's angel called out from heaven, 'Stop! Do not hurt the boy! Now I know that you truly trust God above all.'
scenes.tetum_translation: Loron ida, Maromak koko Abraão nia laran hodi husu nia atu sakrifika nia oan stima Isak iha foho Moria. Maski nia laran triste, Abraão fiar Maromak ho laran tomak no halo tuir. Bainhira Abraão foti nia liman ho fiar kle'an, Maromak nia anju bolu husi lalehan, 'Para! Keta estraga labarik ne'e! Agora Ha'u hatene katak ó fiar duni Maromak liu buat hotu.'
scenes.scene_summary: Abraham demonstrates absolute trust in God on Mount Moriah, and God's angel stops him from harming Isaac.

scenes.title: Jehovah Jireh, Father of Faith
scenes.english_text: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught in a bush by its horns, provided by God Himself as a substitute. Abraham named that place 'The Lord Will Provide.' God blessed Abraham abundantly, promising that through his family, all the nations of the earth would be blessed. Abraham became known forever as the great father of faith.
scenes.tetum_translation: Abraão hateke ba leten no haree bibi-rafe ida metin iha ai-ramu laran, ne'ebé Maromak rasik providensia. Abraão fó naran ba fatin ne'e 'Na'i sei Providensia.' Maromak haraik bensaun barak ba Abraão, no promete katak ho nia família, nasaun hotu iha raiklaran sei simu bensaun. Abraão sai koñesidu ba nafatin nu'udar fiar-na'in katuas boot.
scenes.scene_summary: God provides a ram in the thicket, and Abraham names the place 'The Lord Will Provide,' blessed as the father of faith.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Abraham showed us that true faith means obeying God and trusting His timing, because God always keeps His promises.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Abraão hatudu mai ita katak fiar loloos dehan halo tuir Maromak no fiar Nia tempu, tanba Maromak beibeik kumpre Nia promesa sira.
reflection.discussion_question_en: Is there something difficult God wants you to obey or wait for patiently this week at home or school? How can you trust Him like Abraham did?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Iha buat susar ruma ne'ebé Maromak hakarak ó atu halo tuir ka hein ho pásia iha uma ka eskola iha semana ne'e? Oinsá ó bele fiar ba Nia hanesan Abraão halo?
